drivers.variant_notes: Oliver's 2004 free-play firmware for the same machine, replacing U2/U6 with skat2732.u2 and 7406fn.u6. The archive's info.txt enables free play with S25 and S26 both ON. PinMAME declares the same controller, display, sound and flipper topology, and the retained service test gives the same thirteen coil pairings.

drivers.description: Skateball (Improved attract mode, Free Play rev. 3)
drivers.variant_notes: Oliver's 2005 improved-attract/free-play revision 3 for the same machine, replacing U2/U6 with skate02.u2 and skate02.u6 and retaining the same 823-02_4.716 sound. PinMAME declares the same topology and the retained service test gives the same thirteen coil pairings; no edition hardware change is evidenced.
Production 1980 firmware for Bally Game 1210: GEN_BY35, dispBy7, FLIP_SW(FLIP_L), lampCol 0 and SNDBRD_BY51. This definition's physical reference.

sources.locator: Fresh empty-state coil tests of skatebll, skatebla and skateblb pair 13 factory display numbers with exact public outputs. Matching display segment words, timestamps, raw traces, ROM archives and binary and scenario hashes are pinned. skatebll flipper/tilt run proves 82 -> 45/46, 84 -> 47/48, tilt 7 drops 19 and suppresses subsequent flipper output. Reproduced by tools/skateball_runtime_summary.py; host input readback is not ROM evidence. The documented N/U loads at continuous 17/20 have unexplained published startup state; exact 17-20 burst edges are retained as observations, not assigned a reset cause.
